name: @huai_xin/dsh-memory
description: Cross-session long-term memory, per-session presets and periodic reminders for DeepSeek-Harness: YAML memory notebooks injected into the prompt, read and edited by the model, kept in sync across sessions, plus Markdown presets that replace the harness identity and a reminder appended alongside the user's own message every N turns.

scripts.test: node --test test/core.test.mjs test/store.test.mjs test/schema.test.mjs test/log.test.mjs test/settings.test.mjs test/bootstrap.test.mjs test/reminder.test.mjs test/notification-scheduler.test.mjs
